selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume advertisement featuring dynamic floral elements, clear campaign typography, and high-end product rendering suitable for design reference.

analysis.composition: Asymmetrical balance with the product and floral explosion on the left counterweighted by negative space and typography on the right.
analysis.negative_space: Significant dark gradient space on the right utilized for text placement.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic studio lighting with high contrast, highlighting the faceted glass and metallic cap against a dark background.
analysis.typography: Clean white sans-serif logo and serif tagline positioned in the right negative space; URL at the bottom.
analysis.information_density: Moderate; focuses on brand identity and a single tagline without clutter.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved flat-lay still life featuring perfume and candle with elegant stationery props and integrated handwritten campaign copy.

analysis.composition: Geometric flat-lay arrangement utilizing overlapping rectangular envelopes and cards to frame the products diagonally.
analysis.negative_space: Structured by layered cream and black paper elements, creating distinct zones.
analysis.lighting: Soft, diffused top-down studio lighting with gentle, natural drop shadows.
analysis.typography: Handwritten script campaign copy ('Will you be my valentine?') placed directly on a prop envelope.

selection_reason: High-quality dynamic product shot capturing the spray mechanism in action against a clean gradient background. Excellent reference for minimalist perfume photography and liquid texture rendering.

analysis.composition: Diagonal orientation of the bottle creates dynamic movement, balanced by the spray plume extending into the upper left negative space.
analysis.negative_space: Generous gradient grey space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the fine mist particles.
analysis.lighting: Crisp studio lighting with high specular highlights on the glass and metal atomizer; soft drop shadow anchors the floating object.
analysis.information_density: Low; focus is entirely on the product form and function.

selection_reason: Highly resolved botanical still-life with dynamic levitation composition and clean negative space; excellent reference for natural/organic perfume positioning.

analysis.composition: Diptych layout featuring a levitating product surrounded by botanicals on the left, mirrored by an isolated floating botanical arrangement on the right; grounded by sharp cast shadows.
analysis.negative_space: Expansive, uniform pale green background providing high contrast for floating elements.
analysis.lighting: Hard, directional studio lighting creating distinct, sharp drop shadows beneath suspended subjects.
analysis.information_density: Low; purely visual focus on product and ingredients.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved luxury perfume still-life featuring the L'Eau Rêvée collection. High-quality lighting, elegant composition with botanical props, and clear product visibility make it an excellent design reference.

analysis.negative_space: Moderate negative space provided by the textured stone background, balancing the multiple subjects without feeling cluttered.
analysis.lighting: Hard, directional sunlight creating sharp, dramatic shadows and bright caustic refractions through the glass bottles and sculpted caps.
analysis.typography: None visible outside of product labels.
analysis.information_density: Medium; focuses entirely on the product range and atmospheric styling.

selection_reason: Highly resolved conceptual still-life featuring a Cartier fragrance integrated with vintage Edison bulbs. Strong visual metaphor and premium execution make it an excellent design reference.

analysis.composition: Symmetrical arrangement with the perfume bottle centered among hanging lightbulbs at varying heights, mirrored on a reflective surface below.
analysis.negative_space: Deep teal gradient background provides clean negative space around the illuminated subjects.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic practical lighting from the glowing filaments combined with a soft central backlight creating a halo effect behind the bottle.
analysis.typography: None. The text on the bottle is container labeling, not campaign typography.
analysis.information_density: Low, focused entirely on the visual concept and product.

selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life with clear brand identity, high-quality lighting, and cohesive pastel color palette suitable for design reference.
